candidates.title: Trap Bar Deadlift Form Guide: Setup & Technique Tips
candidates.description:
This video is your guide to perfect form, setup, and technique, especially if you're a beginner! The trap bar is an excellent tool for deadlifting, as it's often more accessible and easier on the lower back than a traditional straight bar deadlift.

We'll cover everything you need to know for a safe and effective lift:

→ Proper Foot Position and creating outward tension to engage your glutes.
→ The difference between a Deadlift Pattern and a Squat Pattern setup.
→ How to "Pull the Slack" out of the bar and brace your core.
→ Common Spine Alignment Mistakes and how to fix them
→ Why you need to RESET every cue before a heavy pull.

candidates.title: Master Trap Bar Deadlifts with Perfect Form
candidates.description:
Performing trap bar deadlifts with perfect form is essential to prevent injury and maximize the effectiveness of the exercise. This is one of the greatest exercises for developing full-body strength, and it is easier to learn for most people than the barbell deadlift. I suggest learning to do these before you do conventional barbell deadlifts, and if you haven't already, watch our video on Trap Bar Deadlifts from Blocks as a precursor to this exercise.

Want more deadlift exercises? Check out this article:
